# Amiya's Desk

> Amiya's Desk is Amiya_desi's personal public entry point for writing, project records, Godot game work, homelab notes, public digital services, and contact links.

## Context

- Site: https://sayori.org/
- Owner: Amiya_desi
- Public contact: me@sayori.org
- Languages: Chinese and English
- Purpose: personal identity, public writing, project records, creator tools, and durable links.

This is a personal public desk, not a local business or commercial service site. Public facts are limited to writing, projects, tools, contact links, and technical interests such as Godot, homelab operations, Cloudflare, Obsidian, and AI-assisted development workflows.

## Core Links

- Home: https://sayori.org/

The GeoScore audit API is public under its documented limits and accepts public hostnames only. The hosted Search Gateway instance remains private infrastructure and is not a public API. Paused experiments, private storage, and internal management endpoints are not public services.

## Crawl Policy

Search indexing, real-time AI grounding, AI citation, and model training uses are allowed for public content. The canonical sitemap is linked above, and llms.txt is advertised from the site's HTML head.
